reason: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a local agentmemory REST server, providing memory tools, automatic activity capture, and optional recalled-context injection; the primary purpose is persistent agent memory and context management.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到本地 agentmemory REST 服务，提供记忆工具、活动自动采集和可选的上下文注入。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a local agentmemory REST service for memory tools, automatic activity capture, and optional recalled-context injection.

capabilities: Connects to a local agentmemory REST server
Registers memory management and retrieval tools
Captures session, prompt, tool-use, subagent, workflow, and approval observations
Optionally injects recalled context into system prompts
Can expose destructive or expensive memory operations when explicitly enabled
Provides a generic HTTP endpoint for agentmemory API calls
